original.target_description: Study 5: lack-of-control versus complete-control autobiographical recall; current physical pain on a 0–100 visual slider; unadjusted between-condition t test.

n.sample_role: Participants in Study 5 two-condition experiment and unadjusted pain comparison.
n.exclusions: No Study 5 exclusions or attrition reported. N explicitly stated in Method; no N derived from df.

notes: Identity verified in supplied header: Economic Insecurity Increases Physical Pain; Eileen Y. Chou, Bidhan L. Parmar, and Adam D. Galinsky; Psychological Science 2016, 27(4), 443–454; DOI 10.1177/0956797615625640. Supplied canonical text contains the full primary research article through references. No PDF supplied. Target identified by Study 5 heading, lack-of-control manipulation, pain outcome and p. 449 locator. The printed d = 0.41 and p = .04 belong to the same unadjusted t test. Subsequent adjusted p = .05 has no corresponding printed d and was not combined with this d. Method explicitly reports N = 100 and assigns half to each condition; Results report t(98). The declared Study 5 participant sample is used for the unadjusted comparison without deriving N from df. No separate final analytic count or Study 5 exclusions are printed. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
